cohort: 45 patients treated for impacted teeth at Tel-Aviv University between 2010-2017, compared to 45 age- and sex-matched controls.
finding: There was a statistically significant association between impacted teeth and systemic disease, chief complaint, referral source, treatment duration, and family history of dental anomalies.
mod_finding: There was a statistical trend towards earlier birth week and more caesarean sections in the group with impacted teeth, but this did not reach statistical significance.
